name: BKAWAN
recent: BKAWAN 近期持续进行股份回购，并推进以关联交易方式将 CCM 全部股权出售给 TMK Chemical Bhd 及申请豁免强制全面收购的计划，同时已向交易所申请延长股东通函的提呈期限。此外，公司对 MKH 的全面收购已跨过 95% 门槛。
notable: 公司拟以关联交易方式出售 Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) 的 100% 股权给 TMK Chemical Bhd，并申请豁免强制全面收购义务。
公司已向 Bursa Securities 申请延长向股东提呈有关上述提案的通函草案的期限。
公司对 MKH 的全面收购已跨过 95% 门槛。
risks: 公司近期持续进行股份回购。
董事局主席 Tan Sri Dato' Seri Lee Oi Hian 在公开市场进行了间接权益的股份交易。

recent_en: BKAWAN has been actively buying back its shares and is progressing with the related party disposal of its entire stake in CCM to TMK Chemical Bhd and a proposed exemption from the mandatory general offer, while seeking an extension of time to submit the shareholder circular. Its takeover of MKH has also crossed the 95% threshold.
notable_en: The company proposes to dispose of its 100% equity interest in Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) to TMK Chemical Bhd via a related party transaction, and seeks an exemption from the mandatory general offer obligation.
The company has applied to Bursa Securities for an extension of time to submit the draft circular to shareholders regarding the proposals.
The company's takeover of MKH has crossed the 95% threshold.
risks_en: The company has been continuously buying back its shares.
The Chairman, Tan Sri Dato' Seri Lee Oi Hian, conducted dealings in shares via deemed interest in the open market.
